label: The Drowned Queen’s Map
summary: You win half of a treasure map in a card game in Saltmother. The other half belongs to the most dangerous captain on the Shattered Main.
title: The Drowned Queen’s Map
description: Half a map, a borrowed sloop and a crew of four who joined for the free rum. The other half is tattooed on the arm of Captain Esme Blackwood, who wants your half and would rather not cut you to get it. The Admiralty wants both.

chapterOutlines.title: The Card Game
chapterOutlines.outline: Win the map, get out of the tavern alive, and find yourself a ship.

chapterOutlines.title: The Fog Banks
chapterOutlines.outline: Strike a deal with Blackwood, or race her through the islands.

chapterOutlines.title: The Drowned Queen
chapterOutlines.outline: Reach the treasure before the Admiralty does, and see who keeps their word.

scene.location: The Gilded Gull tavern on the Saltmother docks
scene.summary: Midnight. The last hand is on the table. Your opponent has just bet half of a very old map.

npcs.name: Captain Esme Blackwood
npcs.description: Elected captain six times and unelected never.
personality: keeps her word to the letter
goals: Find the Drowned Queen’s treasure first

npcs.name: Pim Gallow
npcs.description: Joined your crew ten minutes ago for the rum. Turns out he can actually sail.
abilities: Knows a sea shanty for everything

items.name: Half a treasure map
items.description: The western half of the Drowned Queen’s map, inked on sharkskin.
